user.title: TCL TV
user.description: The TV must be on and reachable on the LAN (UDP 6537 / TCP 6553).

error.cannot_connect: No TCL+ / T-Cast remote service answered at this address. Is the TV on?

init.title: TCL TV options
init.description: Optional infrared remote used to turn the TV on (instead of Wake-on-LAN). Leave remote and command empty to keep using WOL.

data_description.power_on_remote: A Home Assistant remote entity from an IR blaster (Broadlink, Xiaomi, ESPHome, etc.).
data_description.power_on_command: Command name learned on that remote, for example Power or power_on.
data_description.power_on_device: Optional device id required by some remotes (e.g. Broadlink learned device name).

error.command_required: Enter the IR command name when an IR remote is selected.
error.remote_required: Select an IR remote when a command name is entered.
